error.not_applied: the console did not take the change, so the previous settings were put back
error.not_confirmed: not confirmed, so nothing was changed

error.pctl_not_ready: the parental-control service is not ready yet: wait a moment, then try again

error.pdm_unavailable: the console's play-data service is not available right now; try again in a moment
error.pt_not_understood: the console's play-timer settings are in a format {0} does not understand, so nothing was changed. Send a report: About › Help & diagnostics › Send a report online.
error.read_only: read-only mode is on, so nothing was changed: turn it off in About › Help & diagnostics › Developer › Read-only mode
error.read_only_fw: read-only mode is on, as this firmware is not checked yet, so nothing was changed: Console › Compatibility opens the firmware screen, where it can be turned off
error.relock_failed: the console was unlocked but parental controls could not be turned back on: do it now (Today › Turn back on)
error.service_denied: the system refused {0} access to one of its services; {0} needs a console running Atmosphère
error.session_closed: the system closed the session; try again
error.state_unknown: the current play-timer state could not be read, so nothing was written
error.unlock_not_effective: the system did not confirm the temporary unlock; use the parental-control icon in the HOME menu, then try again
error.write_gated: the play timer is running; unlock parental controls temporarily first
error.wrong_pin: the system refused the PIN: wrong PIN, or not 4 to 8 digits
